product.title: Sunset Hiking Tour in the Rocky Mountains near Denver

description.text: In Denver, do you want to go for a hike but don't know which trail to pick, and don't want to get lost in the forest? We make things easy for you by taking you to a beautiful trail that wouldn't be easy to find on your own, and we'll make sure you have a stress-free time, enjoying the natural beauty of the Rocky Mountains. Stops include Rocky Mountain Trailhead, Sunset Overlook. We'll hike for 1.5-2 hours in the Rocky Mountains while the sun sets. Ideal for visitors basing in Denver who want a guided Front Range experience without coordinating transport, trailheads, or mountain logistics on their own.
